How fast is free Canadian shipping, and can I pick up Christmas gifts locally in Edmonton?

Standard studio preparation takes 1 to 3 business days, and free tracked shipping across Canada is included on all Christmas items (typically 2 to 7 business days in transit; order by December 16 for pre-Christmas Canadian courier delivery). Local shoppers in Edmonton and surrounding Alberta communities can also select South Edmonton appointment pickup in the cart and receive a 10% thank-you promo code toward their next order.
What is your return policy on Christmas décor, tree toppers, and ornaments?

Unused standard Christmas décor, tree toppers, figurines, trinket trays, and ornaments are covered by our 30-day return window from delivery. Custom-sized or personalized photo gifts are made specifically for your order and are excluded from change-of-mind returns.
